parameters.label: Land Area
parameters.helpText: The plot as titled. 1 katha = 720 sqft; the sqft figure below is the same land, not additional.

parameters.label: Land Area (sqft)
parameters.helpText: The same plot in square feet, for formulas that work in sqft throughout.

parameters.label: Adjoining Road Width
parameters.helpText: Drives the permissible FAR under the Rajuk rules, so it is an estimating input and not just an address detail.

parameters.label: Floor Area Ratio (FAR)
parameters.helpText: Permissible total floor area as a multiple of the plot. Set by road width and location.

parameters.label: Maximum Ground Coverage
parameters.helpText: The share of the plot the building may sit on at ground level.

parameters.label: Floors Above Ground
parameters.helpText: Counting the ground floor. Basements are counted separately below.

parameters.label: Basement Levels
parameters.helpText: Each level adds excavation, shoring, dewatering and a ramp — quantities no other parameter implies.

parameters.label: Total Built-up Area
parameters.helpText: Every floor added together, including common areas. The single most used driver in any estimate template.

parameters.label: Typical Floor Plate
parameters.helpText: One repeating floor. Multiplied by the storey count it gives most of the built-up area.

parameters.label: Ground Floor Area
parameters.helpText: Usually smaller than a typical floor once parking and setbacks are taken out.

parameters.label: Floor-to-Floor Height
parameters.helpText: Drives column length, brickwork, plaster and riser lengths.

parameters.label: Common Area
parameters.helpText: Lobby, stairs, lifts and corridors as a share of built-up area.

parameters.label: Saleable Area
parameters.helpText: What is actually sold, common area included at the share the deed states.

parameters.label: Parking Spaces
parameters.helpText: A planning obligation as much as a facility; drives ramp, ventilation and floor area.

parameters.label: Construction Duration
parameters.helpText: Drives site overhead, preliminaries and escalation, all of which are time-based rather than quantity-based.

parameters.label: Total Units
parameters.helpText: Flats, shops or offices — whatever this project sells or lets by the unit.

parameters.label: Reinforcement Norm
parameters.helpText: Steel per square foot of built-up area. The standard shortcut for pricing rebar before the bar-bending schedule exists.

parameters.label: Painting Area
parameters.helpText: Wall and ceiling area, which runs to roughly three times the floor area once both faces are counted.

parameters.label: Clear Height
parameters.helpText: Underside of truss to finished floor. Drives column, cladding and crane costs together.

parameters.label: ETP Capacity
parameters.helpText: Effluent treatment, which is a compliance condition for most manufacturing here rather than an option.

parameters.label: Earth Filling
parameters.helpText: Usually the largest single item on a low-lying site, and the one most often under-measured.

parameters.label: Members Strengthened
parameters.helpText: The share of columns and beams needing jacketing or wrapping, which is what separates a refit from a rebuild.

parameters.label: Price Escalation
parameters.helpText: Applied over the construction period. Rod and cement move enough in a year to matter on a long job.

parameters.label: Landowner Share
parameters.helpText: The joint-venture split. On a share project this decides how much of what is built is the developer's to sell.

estimateTemplates.name: Commercial — Standard Estimate
estimateTemplates.description: Office or retail core and shell through tenant-ready fit-out. Answer built-up area, storeys and floor height. Rates are indicative — re-price before use.

estimateTemplates.name: Hospitality — Standard Estimate
estimateTemplates.description: Hotel or resort, including the FF&E and pre-opening supplies that make it tradeable. Answer built-up area, room count and F&B covers. Rates are indicative — re-price before use.

estimateTemplates.name: Industrial — Standard Estimate
estimateTemplates.description: Factory, warehouse or plant. Answer shed area, clear height, crane capacity and machine foundation count. Rates are indicative — re-price before use.

estimateTemplates.name: Infrastructure — Standard Estimate
estimateTemplates.description: Road, bridge or drainage scheme. Answer road length, carriageway width, culvert count and bridge span. Rates are indicative — re-price before use.

estimateTemplates.name: Institutional — Standard Estimate
estimateTemplates.description: School, hospital or civic building. Answer built-up area, storeys and the room counts that apply. Rates are indicative — re-price before use.

estimateTemplates.name: Land Development — Standard Estimate
estimateTemplates.description: Turning raw land into serviced plots. Answer land area, plot count, filling depth and internal road length. Rates are indicative — re-price before use.

estimateTemplates.name: Mixed Use — Standard Estimate
estimateTemplates.description: Retail podium under residential or office floors. Answer built-up area, storeys, units per floor and shop count. Rates are indicative — re-price before use.

estimateTemplates.name: Renovation & Retrofit — Standard Estimate
estimateTemplates.description: Refurbishment or strengthening of an existing building. Answer retrofit area, demolition area and the strengthening percentage. Rates are indicative — re-price before use.

estimateTemplates.name: Residential Apartment — Standard Estimate
estimateTemplates.description: Premium Dhaka apartment block at 2026 market rates. Quantities are formulas over built-up area, storeys and units per floor. Statutory fees, finance cost and land are calculated separately.
